direction: Hand-drawn accent layer within a product site

proposedRoleDescriptions.color: Use selective illustration and highlight fills rather than giving every control a hand-drawn treatment. Keep action roles consistent.
proposedRoleDescriptions.typography: Use a clear sans hierarchy for product copy and controls; illustration lettering belongs to artwork rather than the general reading system.

limits.semanticRoles: Null roles are deliberate. Element measurements do not establish canonical site-wide roles or scales.
limits.visibility: Nonzero element geometry does not prove visibility through loaders or overlays. Computed family requests do not prove successful font loading.
limits.coverage: Selected desktop samples and a supplied reference image when available; no complete responsive, interaction or accessibility audit.
limits.sourceDifferences: The reference supports the illustration layer. It does not establish a hand-drawn application UI or the motion timing claimed in the source.
limits.ownership: Third-party reference, not an approved production pack.
